cannot_hand_in.month_running: The month is not over yet. It can be handed in once it has ended.
cannot_hand_in.timer_running: Stop the timer that is still running, then hand the month in.

toasts.not_recomputed: Could not bring it up to date

team_time.title: Team time
team_time.not_permitted: This is not yours to see
team_time.counted_anywhere: Everyone's hours are counted wherever they logged them. Closing a month freezes its figures; nothing recorded afterwards changes them.
team_time.as_things_stand: Figures are as things stand on {date}; the month is not over.
team_time.not_permitted_detail: Everyone's hours are only readable by whoever looks after the team. Your own month is on {page}.

summary.as_of: As things stand on {date}. The month is not over.
summary.not_started: This month has not started yet.
summary.needs_review: Some days need looking at — hours that were counted before are no longer there.
summary.timer_running: A timer is still running, so this month cannot be handed in yet.

day_table.not_yet: This day has not happened yet.
day_table.needs_review: Hours counted here earlier are no longer there

overview_table.nobody_yet: Nobody has an employment record yet.

reopen.title: Reopen {month}?
reopen.body: {person}'s month has been closed and its figures frozen. Reopening keeps the closed version and records this one alongside it — nothing that was agreed is overwritten.
reopen.label: Why is it being reopened?
reopen.placeholder: Three days in the second week were logged against the wrong month.

people.title: People
people.subtitle: Who the company employs, and the terms each of them works under.
people.nobody_yet: Nobody has an employment record yet. Add someone to start counting their hours.
people.footnote: Somebody who leaves is marked as having left rather than removed, so the months they worked stay readable.
people.not_permitted_detail: Only whoever looks after the team can change who is employed and on what terms.
people.add_hint: Pick the account whose hours this record will count.
people.everybody_added: Everybody already has an employment record.
people.modal_hint: Terms and a working week decide what this person's month comes to, so they are set together.
people.is_manager: Looks after the team, and can see everyone's hours
people.records_target: Record hours owed and a running balance
people.records_target_hint: Off for self-invoicing arrangements, where the company records what was worked and nothing is owed by the day.
people.schedule_hint: Hours owed on each day. Type 7:42 or 7.7, and leave a day blank when it is not worked.

errors.bad_duration: One of the days is not a length of time. Type 7:42 or 7.7, or leave it blank.
errors.hire_date_required: Say when this person started, so their first month knows where to begin.

entries.hint: Hours on this day that no work item accounts for. Months that happened before the company used Plane are entered here too.
entries.none_yet: Nothing recorded on this day yet.
entries.note_placeholder: What this time was spent on
entries.month_closed: This month has been closed, so its hours can no longer be changed. Reopen it first if something needs correcting.

errors.bad_duration: Say how long it was. Type 1:30 or 1.5.

imports.title: Bring hours in
imports.subtitle: Months recorded somewhere else, read from a spreadsheet and checked before anything is written.
imports.not_permitted_detail: Only whoever looks after the team can bring hours in.

columns.time_entries: Columns: email, date, and either hours or minutes — those exact headings. A note column is kept if there is one. 7:42, 7.7 and 462 all read as the same length of time.
columns.absences: Columns: email, start_date, end_date and type — those exact headings. Leave end_date out for a single day.
columns.opening_balances: Columns: email, effective_on for the day it applies from, and either hours or minutes for the balance itself — those exact headings.

imports.preview_hint: Nothing has been written yet. Check the rows below, then apply.
imports.none_yet: Nothing has been brought in yet.
imports.undo_body: Every hour this file wrote is removed, and nothing else is touched. Hours in a month that has since been closed stay where they are.
